Crazy K’s Entertainment & Photo Booth Services entertains all types of functions, from weddings to corporate affairs and everything in between. We offer performances for small groups of twelve people up to hundreds of people.

Performance locations range from backyard parties to the most prestigious banquet sites and hotels in the Lehigh Valley and surrounding areas. No matter the size or location of your upcoming event, we can provide the quality entertainment you are looking for.

MEET KEVIN.
FEEL THE ENERGY.

20+ years of DJ experience, from New York clubs to Lehigh Valley celebrations.

One of the most important aspects of a DJ service is a personality that can adapt to different audiences and occasions. Your DJ is a reflection of your party. The DJ isn’t the main attraction, but a good DJ brings life to the party, providing motivation and enthusiasm when needed. We will do our best to keep your guests dancing!

Entertaining is our passion. Much of our business comes from referrals, which is all the more reason to give you our best at every performance. Our objective is for you and your guests to have the time of your lives.

PRO SOUND. READY TO GO. Equipment & options

We bring top-notch, well-maintained equipment to every job. Mackie/VocoPro mixers and top-of-the-line computer systems are standard. Our sound systems include quality QSC amplifiers, JBL Professional speaker systems and wireless microphones for special announcements and speeches. Music is in CD, MP3 or computerized digital format.

Our systems are regularly checked and maintained for a consistently high-quality performance. We carry a backup system to every performance. Our karaoke and MP3 music is purchased from licensed professional music and radio programming management companies, and we carry proof of purchase.

We have many exciting options to enhance your event. Let us customize the perfect package that is uniquely you. With Crazy K’s Entertainment & Photo Booth Service, your entertainment dollars are well spent. Call Crazy K’s for all your entertainment needs!
